plan.summary: Base-building week focusing on aerobic volume. One quality tempo session, progressive long run on Sunday, easy runs to fill volume.

sessions.description: Tempo run, 5 km at threshold pace

review.summary: The week of June 8–14 closed with 32.0 km across 4 runs, anchored by a strong 17.6 km long run at 6:17/km with 106m elevation on Sunday. Solid tempo effort mid-week at 4:48/km for 5 km. Easy volume outside the long run was light (6.0 km + 3.4 km) — adding one more easy run would boost aerobic stimulus.
highlights: 17.6 km long run with 106m elevation — strongest aerobic stimulus in 14 days
5.0 km tempo at 4:48/km shows solid speed development
areas_to_improve: Easy run volume too low outside long run — add one 8-10 km easy day
No gym sessions logged — need to integrate strength work
Replace ad-hoc fast efforts with structured intervals
